question: When will I get a promotion?

sections.title: Career & profession
paras: Career & profession is read from your Karma bhav (house 10, sign Taurus), ruled by Venus. Overall this area is moderate in your chart.
Helping: …placed in a kendra/trikona (4), supportive; Jupiter aspects house 10.
Holding back: Ketu aspects house 10; In D10, house 10 lord Jupiter sits in house 8.

Periods that activate it: Jupiter–Saturn (2 January 2026 – 15 July 2028); Jupiter–Venus (27 September 2031 – 28 May 2034); Saturn–Saturn (15 November 2039 – 18 November 2042). One of them is running now.

remedies.approach: The planet rules difficult houses for your ascendant – pacify it: daana, service, japa, fasting; do not wear its gem.
steps: Mantra: every day, or at least every Saturday, say “Om Praam Preem Praum Sah Shanaye Namah” 108 times (ॐ प्रां प्रीं प्रौं सः शनये नमः).
Prayer: Dasharatha's Shani Stotra and Hanuman Chalisa on Saturdays
Give (daana): black sesame, mustard oil, iron, black blanket · Saturday evening, to labourers, the elderly, the disabled or the poor
Daily habit: Be punctual, honest and patient; treat servants and workers fairly; avoid alcohol and meat (at least on Saturdays).
Temple visit (when possible): Darbaranyeswarar (Saneeswaran) Temple, Thirunallar, Puducherry – best on Saturday; Shani Peyarchi.
Do NOT wear this planet's gem (Blue sapphire (Neelam)) – it would make the problem stronger.
